ja.$description: Any run marked lang="ja": M PLUS 1 Code, then the mono stack.

dot.$description: Rain, boot, curtain and the rain switch. Never reading text.

medium.$description: Medium weight for marks, labels and headings.

meta.$description: Meta lines, hints, chips, the status line and the footer (13px).

ui.$description: Header, controls, terminal text and code blocks (14px).

read-compact.$description: Article body below 720px, and the command field on touch (16px).

min.$description: Article title, smallest end of its fluid size (24px).

max.$description: Article title, largest end of its fluid size (38px).

min.$description: Entry names in stream rows, smallest end (22px).

max.$description: Entry names in stream rows, largest end (34px).

min.$description: The name as a terminal line, smallest end (28px).

max.$description: The name as a terminal line, largest end (44px).

rain.$description: Rain glyphs. DotGothic16 is drawn for 16px, so this is pixels on purpose.

tight.$description: Tight line height for display lines.

ui.$description: Line height for page text and chrome.

read.$description: Line height for Japanese article body.

1.$description: Space step 1 (4px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

2.$description: Space step 2 (8px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

3.$description: Space step 3 (12px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

4.$description: Space step 4 (16px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

5.$description: Space step 5 (20px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

6.$description: Space step 6 (24px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

7.$description: Space step 7 (28px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

10.$description: Space step 10 (40px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

12.$description: Space step 12 (48px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

18.$description: Space step 18 (72px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

0-5.$description: Space step 0-5 (2px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

1-5.$description: Space step 1-5 (6px). Use for gaps, padding and margins that repeat; one-off layout numbers stay literal.

frame.$description: Maximum content width of the frame.

read.$description: Article measure from 720px: 40 full-width characters at the body size.

read-compact.$description: Article measure below 720px: 40 full-width characters at the body size.

lede.$description: Measure of Latin ledes and captions, in ch (68ch). A number because DTCG dimensions allow only px, em and rem; use as calc(var(--mx-size-measure-lede) * 1ch).

strong.$description: Strong border, and the focus ring width (2px).

control.$description: Corner radius of controls. Panels and the logo have no radius.

phone.$description: Breakpoint phone (600px). Media queries cannot read custom properties, so CSS uses this literal; lint allows only the four breakpoints.

tablet.$description: Breakpoint tablet (720px). Media queries cannot read custom properties, so CSS uses this literal; lint allows only the four breakpoints.

desk.$description: Breakpoint desk (1100px). Media queries cannot read custom properties, so CSS uses this literal; lint allows only the four breakpoints.

wall.$description: Breakpoint wall (1360px). Media queries cannot read custom properties, so CSS uses this literal; lint allows only the four breakpoints.

count.$description: Cursor blinks five times, then stays lit.

duration.$description: A side of the switch becoming current.

steps.$description: Steps of the wipe; compose as steps(var(--mx-motion-wipe-steps)).

duration.$description: One cycle of the drop through the idle strand of the switch.
The name doubling on return to 人間用.
Text settling out of corpus glyphs.

min.$description: Shortest fall of one rain column (9s).

max.$description: Longest fall of one rain column (21s).

min.$description: Shortest fall of one stream strand (5s).

max.$description: Longest fall of one stream strand (11s).

failsafe.$description: The intro ends no later than this.

fallback.$description: After this the recorded session gets its scrolling page back.

rain.$description: z-index of the rain layer. Every z-index comes from this list.

scanline.$description: z-index of the scanline layer. Every z-index comes from this list.

lifted.$description: z-index of the lifted layer. Every z-index comes from this list.

overlay.$description: z-index of the overlay layer. Every z-index comes from this list.

status.$description: z-index of the status layer. Every z-index comes from this list.

boot.$description: z-index of the boot layer. Every z-index comes from this list.

curtain.$description: z-index of the curtain layer. Every z-index comes from this list.

skip.$description: z-index of the skip layer. Every z-index comes from this list.
